text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is a naturally gifted
racer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She dreams of running in exciting races
where she
can "twinkle." Her journey
towards the Twinkle
Series starts now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I vow to help her grow
into a
spectacular racer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
